_note: r0C_demo lean controller (privileged_demo_assisted). Values tagged 'demo' come from OFFLINE statistics of the public demos (demos/analysis/task_stats.json, grasp_cycles.csv, classify_objects 100 episodes 200-299); the runtime never reads demo files. Native action limit is never set here.

motion._note: 0.10 rad/action = the R6/RobotIO cap that worked natively. Cartesian segments solve IK once per waypoint (seeded from measured joints) instead of once per action, to cut wall time.
motion._local_ik_note: it3: seeded DLS IK on the URDF chain (tasks/classify_objects/kin.py) first, native IK as fallback; min_joint_above_table_m keeps joint3..6 origins above the table
motion._seed_note: natural elbow-up seeds for local IK reachability checks (from offline URDF FK study, debug/kin_offline.py)

survey._note: TCP offsets from the home TCP; x is applied outward (sign of the arm base x). Clears the home-pose grippers out of the head view (POSTMORTEM 3.1 #1: 41/81 plans undercounted, objects hidden under the parked grippers).

grasp._tilts_demo: demo approach tilt from vertical p10/p50/p90 = 3.8/11.2/22.2 deg; median tried first
grasp._pregrasp_demo: demo pregrasp height above grasp point p50 0.112 m (p10 0.043, p90 0.167)
grasp._height_demo: demo grasp TCP above table p10/p50/p90 = 0.022/0.035/0.059 m; we grasp 2 cm below the observed top (at most half the height), then raise until the URDF hand clears the table
grasp._close_demo: demo n_grasp (close command to settled) p50 9 frames
grasp._attempt_demo: demo: 11.7% of grasp cycles were empty/near-closed (<0.03) and were regrasped
grasp._preshape_note: it4: approach with jaws opened to width/2+1.8 cm per finger (finger = g*0.054-0.01, X5 gripper_scale); closed fingers > max(width/2+1.2 cm, 2.6 cm) = blocked grasp (it3 dev04 pen: 0.039/0.031 vs normal 0.005-0.008)
grasp._consistency_note: off: in the dev02 swap the two objects had similar heights; a strict check would mostly turn noisy relocations into lost objects

carry._transit_demo: demo carry peak EE z p50 1.065 m = TCP ~0.925 = table(0.765)+0.16; peak 0.128 m above grasp point
carry._plan_note: it3: whole grasp->release joint path planned before moving (local IK, each waypoint seeded from the previous); shapes lift-then-travel and diagonal; release rotations = held, held rotated pi about the approach axis, pitch fan; min joint travel wins

release._release_demo: demo releases as soon as the hand is over the basket (place descent p50 0.0 m) with the TCP 0.087 m above table (~rim height 0.843 + hanging object). We release with the object bottom 1.5 cm above the observed rim.
release._offset_demo: demo release xy: y ~ 0.033 vs basket centre y ~0.047 (-0.014); left arm into left basket +0.011 x; right arm into right basket 0.0; centre basket: left arm -0.039, right arm +0.041 (each arm stays on its own half)
release._pitch_note: release hand orientation fan: pitched forward along the arm radial direction. Straight-down release over the baskets (y~0.03, ~0.48 m from the bases) was IK-infeasible for all 6 arm/basket pairs on DEV0 probe (it1). Demo ep200 keyframes show the hand pitched forward over the far baskets.
release._it5_note: it5: elongated objects (length/width>=3) released with half their length of clearance below the TCP; side-basket release 3.5 cm off the centre line towards the arm (dev03 it4: white basket has a central divider; a vertical pen lowered onto it was ejected off the table)

relay._relay_demo: demo ep200: an object on the far side was set down on the table centre by its own-side arm and re-grasped by the other arm (no in-air handover, no simultaneous holds in 100/100 episodes)
relay._spot_note: candidate table spots near the centre line (demo ep200 relay used the table centre); a spot must be >=0.08 m from pending objects and >=0.07 m in front of the basket row; both arms must have IK there
relay._yaw_note: it5: vertical drop yaw candidates; the first yaw whose resulting object pose has a whole-path route for the receiving arm is used

plan._category_demo: demo ep200: a black pen and a white pen went to the same basket (same type, different colour); 6-10 grasp cycles per episode (6-9 objects)
plan._cross_demo: demo grasp x by arm: left-arm grasps at x>0 max +0.142 (52/367), right-arm grasps at x<0 min -0.162 (23/335); farther cross-side objects use the table relay
plan._cross_note_it4: it4: raised 0.15 -> 0.22 because every direct route is now whole-path IK-checked; fewer table relays (relay relocation swapped two objects on dev02 it3)

budget._demo: demo actions per object p50 100 (cycle p25 79); episode p50 686 of 1100; tail after last release ~25 frames

_table_demo: demo-measured table top z = 0.765 (DEMO_SUMMARY 2); runtime uses the median measured support plane, this is only the fallback
